description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key (a free key is enough). The bulk SpaceNexus datasets: for each one its CSV and JSON download links, what it holds, its columns, its licence statement, its DOI when minted and the page that shows it, plus the Promise Ledger CSV. The downloads themselves need no key.

dataset.description: One dataset by slug or a word of its title, e.g. "launch-slips" or "funding".

name: dataset_links
title: SpaceNexus dataset links
